title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.18856v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. When either changes, the optimizer must decide which parts of an evolved harness to reuse or revise, but the harness alone may not explain why earlier edits were made or how they performed. In this work, we study Continual Recursive Self-Improvement (CRSI), a setting for continuing existing harness-optimization methods across compatible benchmarks or policy models. We propose Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) for the harness optimizer, rather than the task-solving policy. SIM groups edits by recurring harness problem and records their rationale, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation context. New attempts extend this history as optimization continues. In our experiments across four domains, SIM achieves higher final scores than harness-only and root-cause-only continuation in cross-dataset and pairwise cross-model comparisons. translated_title: 自我改进记忆实现持续递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 框架优化通常是在固定的策略模型和基准上进行研究的。当其中任何一个发生变化时，优化器必须决定进化后的框架中哪些部分应当复用或修改，但仅凭框架本身可能无法解释之前为何做出某些编辑以及这些编辑的效果如何。在本工作中，我们研究了持续递归自我改进（CRSI），这是一个在兼容的基准或策略模型之间延续现有框架优化方法的设置。我们提出了面向框架优化器（而非任务求解策略）的自我改进记忆（SIM）。SIM按照反复出现的框架问题对编辑进行分组，并记录其理由、预测与实际观察到的结果以及评估上下文。随着优化的持续进行，新的尝试会不断扩展这一历史记录。在我们跨越四个领域的实验中，在跨数据集和成对跨模型比较中，SIM均比仅用框架延续和仅用根因延续的方法取得了更高的最终分数。
tldr: 论文提出面向框架优化器的自我改进记忆（SIM），通过按反复出现的问题分组记录编辑的理由、预测与实际结果及评估上下文，使框架优化方法能够在不同基准和策略模型之间实现持续递归自我改进，并在四个领域的跨数据集与跨模型实验中取得更高的最终分数。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) for the harness optimizer, which groups edits by recurring problems and records their rationale, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation context, enabling continual recursive self-improvement across compatible benchmarks and policy models and achieving higher final scores in experiments across four domains.
